calculation.description: Contrarian 20-session cross-asset residual return, amplified for assets with larger downside than upside semideviation over the trailing 20 sessions. The signal is shifted by one session and uses only completed historical observations.

validation.regime_notes: Positive in every reported regime: 2024-2026 IC 0.172627 (113 dates); 2027-2029 IC 0.082428 (782 dates); 2030 IC 0.112475 (261 dates); 2031 YTD through 2031-10-15 IC 0.124919 (186 dates). The 15-asset cross-section is small, so uncertainty is interpreted conservatively despite the long time series.
